case: D-12 with a pre-pinned 600 s window and 900 s deadline
what_the_long_window_proved: the window was not the cause: the answer arrived well inside 600 s, and the product used that time to attempt the work and then report failure
product_answer: «I stopped retrying because I kept running write_file 8 times without making progress» followed by «Не все изменения файлов выполнены: 5» with letter_0001..letter_0005 all marked as not written

log_evidence.line: tool_call to 'write_file' failed argument validation at arguments.format (enum): 'utf-8_no_bom' is not one of ['text', 'rtf_create', 'rtf_structured', 'rtf_edit', 'docx_merge', 'odt', …]
log_evidence.reading: the model chose a format value that does not exist in the tool schema

log_evidence.line: hermes_cli.friday_user_scope: Private tool refusal: cause=product_user_scope_refused (five times)
Tool write_file returned error: {"error": "Это действие недоступно.", "success": false} — repeated with counters 6, 7, 8, 9, 10
log_evidence.reading: every retry hit the same scope refusal
the agent framework then hard-stopped the tool and the turn ended with an honest failure list

code_path.scope: hermes_cli/friday_user_scope.scoped_file('write_file', {path, content, format}) raises ScopeDenied, which is turned into product_user_scope_refused

root_cause.primary: an unsupported format value is not rejected as a plain argument error; it falls through to the scope gate and comes back as «Это действие недоступно.», which gives the model no way to correct itself
root_cause.secondary: the model guessed a format name instead of using the default, then repeated the identical call under the loop guard

why_this_matters_beyond_d12: every case that asks the product to create a file by name can hit the same trap, because the failure message hides the real cause

proposed_repair.shape: validate format against the published enum before the scope call, and return an explicit error naming the allowed values; keep the scope refusal for genuinely out-of-scope paths
proposed_repair.verification: on an isolated copy: (a) format 'utf-8_no_bom' returns a precise enum error, (b) format 'text' still writes normally, (c) an out-of-scope path still returns product_user_scope_refused
proposed_repair.regression: the existing file-writing cases already captured must keep their verdicts

honest_limits: no product code has been changed yet; this is a diagnosis, not an applied repair
the exact reason scoped_file denied this particular write was not read line by line in friday_user_scope; the repair must confirm it before touching behaviour
